verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official Databricks SDK for Python for automating operations and accelerating development. Its API reference says examples are provided via 'one or more of the Databricks SDKs', and Databricks Connect is an official client library that can be embedded in any application. missing for 10: explicit documentation of SDKs in languages beyond Python, SDK depth (coverage, examples), independent or hands-on corroboration, any AI-native-specific SDK tooling.
